video_title: Knicks Not Close On ANY Contract Extensions | Rachel Nichols & Chris Mannix

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks may not extend any players this offseason
quotes.excerpt: the Knicks may just not extend anybody this offseason
quotes.quote: We have seen some reporting this week that the Knicks may just not extend anybody this offseason. They have a handful of guys that can be extended, and it does not sound like they are going to do that.

quotes.speaker: Rachel Nichols
quotes.summary_phrase: Is Jim Dolan's refusal to pay the second apron a financial or principle issue?
quotes.excerpt: do you think that Jim Dolan saying I absolutely will not go into the second apron is a money cheapness thing?

text_blocks.speaker: Rachel Nichols
text_blocks.text: Do you think that Jim Dolan saying I absolutely will not go into the second apron is a money cheapness thing? Do you think it's a principle thing? Because the whole reason we haven't had a repeat champion in eight years is because the CBA has been increasingly designed so that we don't have one.

text_blocks.speaker: Chris Mannix
text_blocks.text: I don't think Dolan is cheap. I think he's spent money smartly, but he's splurged it on ridiculous things, not the least of which has been front office executives that don't know how to be executives and maybe some coaches that didn't work. He's not been afraid to open up his wallet.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Knicks should have extended Mitchell Robinson
quotes.excerpt: I would have liked to have seen them spend the money to spend to get Mitchell Robinson back
quotes.quote: I would have liked to have seen them spend the money to spend to get Mitchell Robinson back. Mitchell Robinson is a lifelong Knick. He's a big part of not just what they do on the floor, but he's part of that locker room. Not spending on him to me was like, what are you doing here?

quotes.speaker: Rachel Nichols
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart is a multiplier for Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: I really believe that Josh Hart is a multiplier for Jalen Brunson both on and off the court
quotes.quote: It's a little bit of the Draymond Green principle with the Golden State Warriors. If he is the guy who makes your main guy go, if he is a multiplier for your main guy, and I really believe that Josh Hart is a multiplier for Jalen Brunson both on and off the court, that is a value that you pay for.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Deuce McBride is a priority for a long-term deal
quotes.excerpt: The one guy I'm actually more concerned with is Deuce McBride
quotes.quote: The one guy I'm actually more concerned with is Deuce McBride. He's a big part of their bench. If he has a great year, he is going to be way out of their price range. That's a guy I would want to work hard to get on a long-term deal that makes sense. It's like what Boston did with Peyton Pritchard back when they gave Peyton Pritchard what is now the greatest contract in the NBA in terms of value for dollar.

quotes.speaker: Rachel Nichols
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart's comments on contract extensions
quotes.excerpt: You don't want contract extension talks trickling into the season because whenever there's uncertainty, there's going to be a lot of questions

text_blocks.speaker: Rachel Nichols
text_blocks.text: I looked up the Josh Hart quote because I wanted it exactly: 'You don't want contract extension talks trickling into the season because whenever there's uncertainty, there's going to be a lot of questions. We know it's a business. We know if some of the things aren't figured out by February, it might be a different conversation.' And I thought matching that quote up to what Stephen Castle told GQ when he was like, basically we got beaten by the power of friendship. He was like, team chemistry is what beat us.

text_blocks.speaker: Chris Mannix
text_blocks.text: It is delicate, but the why is that it is a very small needle to thread to be able to keep the entire team together. If they just cave and go to Towns, you're peeling off Mikal Bridges in a year.
